_comment: 1.21.1 line, fabric. fabric-api version is fabric_version in 1.21.1/gradle.properties. Runs the standalone in-client UI test harness (uitest/1.21.1-fabric, an independent loom build in this repository) through the three-stage pipeline config->build->test. The harness build stages the two jars under test into the run's mods/ folder itself (production fabric jars are intermediary-named; the loader's dev-mode remapper brings them into the run's namespace) and takes fabric-api as its own remapped Gradle dependency at exactly the pinned version, so jech, jei and fabric-api all carry via=dev-classpath: there is nothing for jt to stage. The row is a harness row since this move (2026-10-15): it declares no ready_when and no world, because the harness's own runner creates and pins its flat level and quits the client when the selection is done.
